text:
andre: Running the monthly pattern analysis — attached summary shows top recurring signatures X1..X5. Focusing this thread on owners + realistic remediation windows.

maria: Thanks andre. Can we prioritize X2 and X4? X2 is causing most customer impact.

sana: I own X1 but I need infra sign-off for the kernel backport (PR #5632). Waiting on review.

kevin: For X2 I propose a two-phase plan: short-term mitigation (circuit-breaker + alert tuning) and long-term fix (rewrite request router). I can lead the short-term.

lucy: I can be the long-term owner for X2. I'll draft design doc this week.

andre: Great. Assigning tentative timelines: X1 P1 3w (blocked on infra), X2 short-term P0 1w, X2 long-term P1 6w, X3 P1 4w, X4 P0 2w, X5 backlog. Please update the tracker: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INC-TRACKER>.

maria: Add acceptance criteria to each action. Example AC for X2 short-term: "no customer-facing 500s for X2 signature in 14d, alert suppressed to sev2 only". Also include rollback plan.

kevin: Short-term mitigation commands I ran in staging:

```
# deploy circuit-breaker rule
rgctl routes update --route routerA --circuit 100 --window 60
# adjust alert threshold
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/alerts -d '{"sig":"X2","threshold":5}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

kevin: Staging smoke looked stable: 0 recurrences in 2h stress test. Will run 24h overnight and post logs.

sana: Infra reviewer pinged me: @infra-team can we get priority review on PR #5632? Without it X1 fix stalls.

incident-bot: Automated note: pattern-scan run 2026-03-05; total recurrences found: 31 across signatures X1..X5. Created follow-ups: PM-1023, PM-1024.

lucy: Drafting the X2 long-term doc now: link will be in the tracker. Planning to include a rollout plan with canary percentages and automatic fallback.

maria: Who owns weekly follow-ups? We need a single thread owner to keep momentum.

andre: I'll own weekly follow-ups for March. Will post a short status every Friday and update the tracker.

kevin: Capacity note: X4 long-term requires adding two nodes in eu-west-1. Filed CAP-7712. Pending approval from capacity owners.

sana: If capacity denies, fallback for X4 is QoS throttling + alerting; longer latency expected. Put fallback in AC.

maria: Please set pragmatic timelines in the tracker (avoid optimistic estimates). If blocked, update status with the blocker ticket.

incident-bot: Reminder: follow-ups should include clear owners, timelines, acceptance criteria, and monitoring queries. Template: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback.

andre: Next steps: owners update tracker by EOD tomorrow, infra/capacity owners to respond to blockers by Tue EOD, kevin will post 24h staging results. I'll schedule a 20-min sync Wed 9am PT if anyone needs to talk live.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you add items to the tracker, also add the monitoring query for automated recurrence detection (example: `count_over_time(errors{sig=\"X2\"}[1d]) > 3`).

lucy: Noted. I'll include the monitoring query in the doc.

kevin: Posting staging logs here after 24h run.

andre: Closing the thread for now — updates go in the tracker and weekly Friday notes. :white_check_mark:
